notes.title: ToSGT Update v1.04
notes.content:
ToS Gamepad Tester v1.04 is live now!

Features & improvements include:

[list]
[*] [b]Slow Framerate/ High GPU Usage Fix[/b] - Slow performance/ high GPU usage has been fixed. (Getting around 1000+ frames with a 6700xt.)
[*] [b]Fixed Dualshock4 Lightbar Selector[/b] - The selector was broken and now it is no longer, you can now correctly choose which colour you want the Dualschock4 lightbar to be.
[*] [b]New Settings[/b] - The video settings have been completely updated and new settings have been added, such as a FPS counter, anti-aliasing options and texture quality options.  
[*] [b]Backend Updated[/b] - The entirety of the backend has been updated including Unity version (fixing the name not appearing correctly in task manager) and all assets with ToS Gamepad Tester. 
[*] [b]Updated Ultrawide Support[/b] - UI on screen now scales better with ultrawide monitors, using the extra space ultrawide provides correctly. 
[*] [b]Localization Updated[/b] - Localization backend has been reworked and updated.
[*] [b]Loading Screen Update[/b] - Loading screen has been updated and you should be able to get into ToSGT faster. 
[*] [b]Updated UI Visuals[/b] - UI buttons colours have been updated to suit to style of the app more; same with some texts styles. 
[/list]

Cheers.

Takeover Studios.

notes.title: ToSGT Update v1.03
notes.content:
ToS Gamepad Tester v1.03 is live now!

Features & improvements include:

[list]
[*] [b]*NEW* Gamepad Cursor[/b] - Press L3 to use the gamepad cursor! No need to use your mouse anymore, control the mouse right from your gamepad!
[*] [b]*NEW* Ultrawide Resolution Support[/b] - Support for 21:9 is now available! Along with the standard 16:9 and new 16:10!

Takeover Studios.

notes.title: ToSGT Update v1.02a
notes.content:
ToS Gamepad Tester v1.02a is live now!

Features & improvements include:

[list]
[*] [b]Gamepad Hardware Names[/b] - Gamepad's hardware names are now shown rather than a generic name of the gamepad.
[*] [b]Layout Selector[/b] - The swap layout button has been changed for the Layout Selector. This should make it easier to switch between layouts. 
[*] [b]General App Layout Changes[/b] - Changes to text, buttons and toggles size and placement for better readability. 
[*] [b]Raw Stick Values Toggle (Testing Upgrade Pack)[/b] - Raw values of both stick and triggers are now on by default, toggle has been renamed to better reflect this change.
[*] [b]Rumble Cooldown (Testing Upgrade Pack)[/b] - Rumble Cooldown has been added to the rumble testing to help prevent errors.
[*] [b]PS4 Battery/Light Bar Visual Updates (Testing Upgrade Pack)[/b] - Battery & Light Bar have been moved for better readibility. 'Light Bar' text added to Light Bar selector. 


[/list]

Cheers.

Takeover Studios.

notes.title: ToSGT Update v1.01a
notes.content:
ToS Gamepad Tester v1.01a is live now!

Features & improvements include:

[list]
[*] [b]*NEW* Built-in Gamepad Deadzone Toggle[/b] - You can now switch between absolute raw input values and your gamepads built-in deadzone for both sticks and triggers. 
[*] [b]Updated Deadzone Backend[/b] - The way values are calculated for when the Deadzone toggle is enabled has been updated to work better. 
[*] [b]Ultra Precision Testing Text[/b] - Ultra Precision Stick Testing text has been updated to reflect new precise trigger testing; it is now simply Ultra Precision Testing. 
[*] [b]Language Fix - Ultra Precision Testing[/b] - Some languages completly broke the Ultra Precision Testing; now they don't.
[*] [b]DS4/5 Gamepad Values Fix[/b] - Using a DS4/5 gamepad while using Precision Testing now gives the correct +/- values on the stick axis as well as for triggers.  
[/list]

Cheers.

Takeover Studios.

notes.title: ToSGT Update v1.01

notes.title: Steam Input Fix & Small Updates
notes.content:
Steam Input backend has been fixed. If you have Steam Input enabled by default, your gamepads configuration will correctly default to 'Gamepad'. Previously, it would default to a keyboard configuration which is why your gamepad may not have been appearing in ToSGT. 

If your gamepad is still not appearing while having Steam Input active you may need to change the controller configuration to 'Gamepad' manually. 

[b]While in game:[/b]
[i]Shift + Tab (Steam Overlay) > Controller Configuration > Browse Configs > Recommended > Gamepad > Apply Configuration.[/i]

Two updates have also been pushed today, v1.0a&b.

4 gamepads can be connected to the base app all at once. (This should help if you have other devices appearing as 'gamepads').

The font styling has been changed for all languages other than English. This fix should make these langauges make more sense now.

[b]If you have any issues, please create a Discussion in the forums as I am more than happy to help with any problems![/b]

Cheers.

Takeover Studios.
